data_coverage.observation_statement: In the available dataset of 500 instrumented traces, 378 (75.6%) contained no detected human intervention signals. Human intervention was detected in 122 (24.4%) traces (96 explicitly observed in telemetry, 26 inferred via reaction latency heuristics).

data_coverage.observation_statement: In the available dataset of 500 instrumented traces, 378 (75.6%) contained no detected human intervention signals. Human intervention was detected in 122 (24.4%) traces (96 explicitly observed in telemetry, 26 inferred via reaction latency heuristics).

evaluation.note: Evaluation spans observed across active workflows.

dependencies.interpretation: Inference expenditure is distributed across a primary and secondary provider.
dependencies.potential_implications: Partial redundancy exists, though major operational shifts in the primary provider would require workflow adjustments.

limitations: Only instrumented agent workflows in available telemetry were analyzed.
Human intervention occurring outside instrumented software systems cannot be detected.
Telemetry-attributable cost excludes infrastructure hosting, human operational labor, and legal governance overhead.
Provider pricing calculations reference static versioned rates (v2026_09) and may differ from custom enterprise contracts.
